TABLE.NAME: local_aiproofreaderreport_optout
TABLE.COMMENT: Roster of students whose parents opted out (via ParentSquare) - excluded from the anonymized export. Each import replaces the full roster.

FIELD.NAME: importedby
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who ran the import.

TABLE.NAME: local_aiproofreaderreport_grantteacher
TABLE.COMMENT: Teachers in the AI Proofreader grant program. When this roster is not empty, reimbursement notifications go only to these teachers (including those with 0 graded). Each upload replaces the full roster.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher's Moodle user id, matched from the uploaded email address.

FIELD.NAME: importedby
FIELD.COMMENT: userid of the admin who uploaded the roster.
